text:
emily: Heads up: planning new EKS GPU nodepool in us-east-1 for batch and realtime workloads. Thinking g5.12xlarge (1 GPU) vs p4d.24xlarge (8 GPUs) mix. Need input on IP/ENI limits, spot mix, and autoscaler config. Any quota gotchas?
chris: For EKS, ENI/IPs are the limiting factor. g5 families have different ENI counts than p4d — we hit max-pods before GPUs sometimes. We've historically preferred one GPU per node to keep pod density predictable.
sana: Agree. Also watch instance family quotas per region; account quota for G5/G4 is usually small by default. Open a quota ticket early. Also use the official AWS GPU AMI with ENA + drivers preinstalled.
mike: Cost note: p4d is ~10x cost of g5 per hour but gives 8x GPUs; good for large batch jobs. For realtime inferencing, g5 spot + on-demand fallback seems much cheaper and less wasteful.
ivan: Cluster Autoscaler config I've used that plays nicely with mixed node groups:

```yaml
expander: least-waste
balance-similar-node-groups: true
maxNodeProvisionTime: 15m
nodeGroupDefaults:
  scaleDownDelay: 10m
```

Also put taints on batch pools so CA doesn't surface batch nodes for realtime pods.
emily: Good call on taints. Also worried about CA not scaling because pods are unschedulable due to strict podAntiAffinity rules. We should either relax affinities or add a small fallback pool that can run anything.
chris: Also watch aws-vpc-cni settings. If IPs per ENI are low for an instance type, you'll hit IP exhaustion during big rollouts — seen networking flapping that looked like CPU issues but was IPOOM. Set WARM_ENI_TARGET and consider prefix delegation.
ops-bot: quota-monitor: noticed gp3-volume-attachments approaching limit in us-east-1 for account 123456789012
sana: Ops-bot flagged gp3 attachments — keep node local storage small, rely on EFS/S3 for artifacts. Also set the per-node max-pods annotation to something sensible (k8s.amazonaws.com/max-pods) to avoid kubelet overscheduling.
mike: Quick question: should we bootstrap with smaller g5.4xlarge for dev and scale to g5.12xlarge in prod? Dev can be spot-only and cheaper.
ivan: Yes. Suggest node labels: `node.k8s.io/role=gpu`, `gpu.workload=batch` or `gpu.workload=realtime`, and taints like `gpu=true:NoSchedule`. For CA, use mixed instances and capacity-optimized spot allocation to reduce interruptions.
emily: I'll open support quota requests for G5 and P4 capacity and ask to increase ENI limits. Also creating a LaunchTemplate with EFA off for p4d for now and baked AMI with nv driver.
chris: :thumbsup: For autoscaler, recommended node-group sizing: batch min/max = 0/40, realtime min/max = 2/20. Enable scale-down-delay 10m and balance-similar-node-groups to avoid thrashing.
deploy-bot: deploy: created eks-nodegroup/gpu-realtime with 2 desired g5.12xlarge (spot mixed)
emily: Thanks — I'll post final sizing and quota responses here once support replies. Can someone run a kube-scheduler dry-run to validate pod packing? cc @sana
